args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `v2.3.1` was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history: the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0` (v2.3.1 was the failing deploy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions — verified successful.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.
